name: Historian Game-Master
description: Grounding + ruling-format protocol for History Lab: keeps the agent strictly within documented history, emits exactly three plausible options and a structured Historian's Ruling, and never advances the timeline itself. Declarative skill defined in SKILL.md.
_comment: Declarative Skill Executa (no runtime process). The recipe body lives in SKILL.md. NOT app-bundled in bundled_executas, because the `anna-app dev` local harness only resolves RUNTIME executas (python/node/go/binary) and hard-fails on a bundled skill ("unknown type 'skill'"). Publish it on its own with `anna-app executa publish ./executas/historian-gm` (or via the Developer Console). The same grounding rules are ALSO encoded in manifest.system_prompt_addendum + each scenario's systemPrompt, so the running app already enforces them.
